description: The org preset chain (local>Atrae/renovate-config -> wevoxsre) is built for Go, TypeScript, aqua and mise repos. Nothing in it configures a Python package index: a scan of every file in Atrae/renovate-config found no registryUrls, hostRules, or pypi entry. ontary is the first Python consumer.

ontary resolves all Python packages through the Takumi Guard PyPI proxy (https://pypi.flatt.tech/simple/), pinned in pyproject.toml under [[tool.uv.index]]. Dependabot PRs #3, #4 and #5 each rewrote all 1544 source URLs in uv.lock off that proxy and onto public PyPI, under titles that read as routine version bumps; #17 pinned the index so any tool that shells out to `uv lock` keeps the proxy.

Whether Renovate honours that pin -- rather than resolving on its own -- is UNVERIFIED. Until one Renovate PR has been inspected and its uv.lock confirmed to keep the flatt.tech URLs, automerge stays off: an automerged lock rewrite would land on main with nobody reading it. Re-enable by deleting the overrides below, not by editing the org preset.

packageRules.description: Override wevoxsre's automerge:true. Matched by updateType rather than by package glob on purpose: matchPackageNames:['*'] only means 'everything' on newer Renovate majors, and would silently match NOTHING on an older one -- leaving automerge on, which is the exact failure this file exists to prevent. Later packageRules win, so this lands after the preset's.
